turns.question: What share of non-cancelled order revenue between 17 August and 2 October 2026 came from orders that have no return at all, in percent?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for the share of revenue from orders without a return: Revenue (EUR) cannot be split by whether an order was returned, so I can't give that percentage for 17 August to 2 October 2026. The closest metrics are Revenue (EUR) (revenue_eur), Returns (EUR) (returns_eur), Net revenue (EUR) (net_revenue_eur, revenue minus partner returns), Return rate (return_rate, share of orders returned) and Returns by order date (returns_on_order_date); I can give any of these for the period if that helps.
